integrity: An unrestricted network reduction and convex minimization prove the all-parameter claim. Standalone seeded checks are supplementary rather than infinite certificates. Historical novelty remains provisional; independent priority and mathematical audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Proves an exact optimal-length formula and constructs one canonical minimizing network for three isosceles point targets with equal radius; does not classify every optimizer, arbitrary nonisosceles triples, or general compact targets. Existing small-radius tripod results and qualitative three-site examples are acknowledged.
title: Exact network-length phases for three isosceles sites under uniform distance tolerance
